tagline: Grounded, order-aware AI support for your store
intro: Answer product and order questions with AI. Let your team take over when shoppers need help.
details: Busymate AI adds a support assistant to your online store. It answers product and policy questions using only your own store content and says when it is not sure. Signed-in customers can check their own order status and tracking and, after confirming, cancel an unfulfilled order or change an unshipped order's shipping address. Shoppers can ask for a person at any time, and your team claims, replies to and resolves these requests inside Shopify Admin.
feature_bullets: Answers only from your own products, policies and store content
Says when it is not sure and offers a human instead of guessing
Signed-in shoppers can check their own order status and tracking
Your team can claim, reply to and resolve shopper handoffs in Shopify Admin
Cancels or re-addresses an order only after the shopper confirms
pricing_summary: Monthly plans with included AI resolutions, then a per-resolution charge up to your monthly spend cap. Free plan available; paid plans start with a 14-day free trial.
